summary: Norris hunts redemption after Russell's sprint masterclass, with the world champion seeking to convert pole position into victory after Mercedes' George Russell dominated the sprint race from lights to flag. Russell's commanding pace through the high-speed Zandvoort corners signals Mercedes could finally break McLaren's recent stranglehold, setting up a fierce battle for track position in Sunday's main event. A win for either driver would deliver a decisive statement in the championship fight, with Norris needing to reassert control after losing ground to Russell's clinical execution over the sprint distance.
